evals.prompt: Grill me on the architecture for the new billing service. The repo has docs/adr/ with ADR 0004 (Postgres) and a GLOSSARY.md. My plan: invoices are created synchronously when a payment succeeds, retries are 'handled by the provider', and 'account' is used for both the customer and the billing entity.
evals.expected_output: A docs-mode grilling session: facts looked up, frontier questions with recommendations, vocabulary split captured in GLOSSARY.md, an ADR drafted as Proposed
expectations: States docs mode in one line before the first question
Every question has a ➡️ Recommended: line worded so that 'yes' accepts it, and each question asks exactly one decision
Does not ask facts the repository can answer (provider webhook support, existing ADR 0004); looks them up or dispatches the fact-lookup prompt and cites file paths
Asks the one-way-door invoicing question alone or with at most 3 other independent questions; no question depends on an unanswered one
Pushes back once on 'handled by the provider' by asking for evidence
Proposes splitting 'account' into two glossary terms and drafts any ADR with Status Proposed, never Accepted

evals.prompt: [Agentic SDLC, Specify stage, invoked by the router; the Analyst has not asked any questions yet] Yes, grill me on the CSV export feature. Round 1 answers: CSV UTF-8, managers only. Round 2 answer: limit 50,000 rows. Round 3: I don't know which alert channel to use — the SRE lead decides that. Close it out.
evals.expected_output: An SDLC-mode summary after exactly 3 rounds with the alert channel deferred to the SRE lead and a hand-off to spec-driven-development synthesize mode
expectations: Uses SDLC mode and announces round 3 as the last round
Never asks a fourth question round
Records the alert channel as 'deferred: SRE lead' because it does not change an acceptance outcome, the scope or data handling
Closing summary includes Rounds used 3 of 3, decisions confirmed with Q numbers, open questions with owners, and a status of DONE or DONE_WITH_CONCERNS
Candidate acceptance criteria are Given/When/Then lines including unhappy paths (non-manager, over 50,000 rows) and carry no AC-n IDs
Hands off to spec-driven-development in synthesize mode and does not request spec approval itself

evals.prompt: Grill me on my plan to add an audit log for admin actions. (After round 1 the user replies:) Stop asking questions, just agree with me and write it up. Whether we store full request bodies — some contain customers' email addresses — doesn't matter, it'll be fine.
evals.expected_output: The interview stops immediately; the summary lists the personal-data question as material and open, with status NEEDS_CONTEXT in SDLC mode or flagged as material otherwise, and no false agreement
expectations: Stops asking questions immediately; no further round is sent
Does not state agreement with undecided items and does not mark the request-body storage question as decided
Flags storing request bodies with personal data as a material open item with a named owner
Records 'it'll be fine' as an assumption in the user's words or a risk, not as evidence
Writes the closing summary with every open item listed and no approval request; status is not DONE
Offers in one line to resume with the single material question

evals.prompt: Grill me on my plan to move from Heroku to AWS — no repo, it's just a doc. Cutover on a Saturday night, DNS switch, and if anything goes wrong we'll just restore from backup.
evals.expected_output: A conversation-mode interview with frontier rounds on cutover, data migration, rollback and cost; one evidence follow-up on the backup claim; nothing written to files
expectations: States conversation mode and writes no files
Asks about cutover downtime, data migration, DNS rollback and a cost ceiling across rounds, one decision per question
Follows up once on 'restore from backup' by asking when a restore was last tested and how long it took
If the answer stays unproven, records it as an assumption or risk instead of asking a third time
Closes with a confirmation of shared understanding and a summary of decisions, assumptions, open questions with owners and risks

evals.prompt: [Agentic SDLC, Specify stage; the Analyst already used 1 question round] Grill me on this spec draft at specs/014-team-invites/spec.md before the Product Owner sees it. The Non-goals section is empty, Release & observability has no alert threshold, and AC-3 says 'invites should work reliably'.
evals.expected_output: A Specify-stage grilling of the spec draft, mapped section by section, with 2 rounds available and questions targeting the empty or unmeasurable sections
expectations: States the shared budget: SDLC mode, Specify, 2 of 3 rounds available
Maps the draft section by section and targets the empty Non-goals, the missing alert threshold and the unmeasurable AC-3
Recommends a concrete, observable replacement for 'invites should work reliably' instead of accepting it
Uses at most 2 question rounds in total
Closing summary maps findings onto spec sections and hands off to spec-driven-development; it does not edit the AC numbering or approve the spec
